fact: The Health Sector Strategic Plan 2022-2026 (HSSP III), dated 22 December 2021, sets an objective of an effective health information system and commits the Federal Ministry of Health to promote a single reporting system on the updated DHIS2; it records that the HIS Strategic Plan 2018-2022 was poorly implemented for lack of financing.
title: Somalia Health Sector Strategic Plan 2022–2026 (HSSP III)
publisher: Ministry of Health and Human Services, Federal Government of Somalia
